blocks.label: Weeks 5-8 · near max effort, one rep in the tank

exercises.name: RDL
exercises.instruction:
Keep a slight knee bend here and push your butt back so that you feel the tension in your hamstrings and glutes. If your knees are locked it will be all hamstrings and we don't want that. We want the glutes involved also, so keep a slight knee bench and squeeze those glutes hard at the top of each rep.
Intensity: 7

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instruction: As these get easier with bodyweight add some weight by either holding a dumbbell between your feet or using a belt with some plates chained to it.

exercises.name: Cable Crunches
exercises.instruction:
Complete as many reps here as you can for each set. Use a weight that has you fail around 12-18 rep range.
Intensity: 9

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instruction: Complete 3 sets of close to max effort on each set here. Leave 1 rep in the tank so it's not complete failure. This might be just bodyweight for you. You might have to use assistance. Or you might be strong enough to use additional weight. The goal here is to fail right around 8-10 rep range. So keep that in mind as you complete your sets.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instruction:
If body weight is easy for you here, then add some weight! 
Intensity: 9

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
exercises.instruction:
3 sets of max effort reps! If you can get more than 20 reps, then add some weight with a dumbbell or a plate.
Intensity: 9
